title: Helios Console Configuration
description: Configuration profile for Helios Console MDM application

jamfPro.title: Jamf Pro Connection
jamfPro.description: Jamf Pro server connection and API credentials

serverURL.title: Server URL
serverURL.description: Full Jamf Pro server URL (e.g., https://myorg.jamfcloud.com)

masterClientID.title: Master Client ID
masterClientID.description: OAuth client ID for the master API integration (used for read-only inventory)

masterClientSecret.title: Master Client Secret
masterClientSecret.description: OAuth client secret for the master API integration

requiredRoleName.title: Required Role Name
requiredRoleName.description: Jamf Pro API role assigned to per-user integrations

screenShareEnabled.title: Enable Screen Share
screenShareEnabled.description: Show the Screen Share action in the device Actions menu. Uses Apple's built-in Screen Sharing app with VPN IP preference (EA_VPN_IP_ADDRESS).

appTitle.title: App Title
appTitle.description: Primary title displayed in the sidebar header

appSubtitle.title: App Subtitle
appSubtitle.description: Subtitle displayed below the app title

localAdministration.title: Local Administration
localAdministration.description: Local admin account settings for LAPS lookups

username.title: Local Admin Username
username.description: Local administrator account name for password lookups

role.title: Operator Role
role.description: Operator role delivered by MDM. Gates the destructive Cleanup feature (Admin-only). Fails closed: a missing, blank, or unrecognized value is treated as the least-privileged User, so Cleanup stays hidden unless the value is exactly 'Admin'. May also be supplied nested under jamfPro.role.

cleanup.title: Stale-Device Cleanup
cleanup.description: Settings for the Admin-only Jamf stale-device cleanup feature.

staleDays.title: Stale Threshold (days)
staleDays.description: Days without check-in before a device is considered stale.

defaultStaticGroupID.title: Default Static Group ID
defaultStaticGroupID.description: Jamf static group ID pre-selected in the cleanup UI (optional).

defaultSiteID.title: Default Site ID
defaultSiteID.description: Jamf site ID pre-selected in the cleanup UI (optional).

enabled.title: Enable Jamf Protect
enabled.description: Master toggle for Jamf Protect features.

password.title: Protect Password
password.description: Jamf Protect API password. Sensitive — managed-pref plists are world-readable; prefer delivering via Keychain and scope this profile tightly.

appleBusinessManager.title: Apple Business Manager
appleBusinessManager.description: ABM API credentials for AppleCare coverage lookups

enabled.title: Enable ABM Integration
enabled.description: Enable Apple Business Manager API lookups

clientID.title: ABM Client ID
clientID.description: Apple Business Manager API client ID

keyID.title: ABM Key ID
keyID.description: Apple Business Manager API key identifier

privateKey.title: ABM Private Key
privateKey.description: ES256 private key for ABM JWT authentication (PEM format)

entra.title: Microsoft Entra Device Cleanup
entra.description: Entra (Graph) cleanup for the Return to Service action. When present, Return to Service also deletes the erased Mac's device object(s) from Entra by displayName so it can re-register cleanly with PSSO / Company Portal. This block only POINTS to the preference domain carrying the Graph credentials — the secrets live in that separate managed-pref domain, not here. Distinct from the 'entraID' user-login block. Omit to disable Entra cleanup.

credentialDomain.title: Credential Domain
credentialDomain.description: Preference domain (bundle identifier) of a separate managed-preferences payload holding the Entra Graph app credentials. Helios (unsandboxed) reads it via UserDefaults(suiteName:). That domain must supply entra_tenant_id, entra_client_id, and at least one of entra_cert_pem (PEM cert+key, preferred PS256 client assertion) or entra_client_secret (fallback). The app registration needs Device.ReadWrite.All AND the 'Cloud Device Administrator' Entra role.

SidebarItems.title: Sidebar Items
SidebarItems.description: Custom sidebar navigation items (optional — uses defaults if omitted)

id.title: Item ID
id.description: Unique identifier for the sidebar item

isEnabled.title: Enabled
isEnabled.description: Whether this sidebar item is visible
